summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the technical challenge of migrating existing MAC addresses and location data to new facilities. One participant described a process where client-provided geo data for a new, unlisted location required creating a new facility ID record, transferring MAC/geo data, and noting that this was also happening with another sensor (001E422E6572). The core technical discussion revolved around the best method for moving existing MACs to newly created facilities. A multi-step approach was proposed: 1) Exporting the file; 2) Adding a new facility row without a MAC; 3) Deleting the MAC from the old facility; 4) Importing; 5) Inserting the MAC into the new facility row; and 6) Importing again. This process was acknowledged as complex, with participants agreeing that further review was needed.
decisions: The multi-step approach for migrating existing MACs to new facilities (export -> add facility -> delete mac -> import -> insert mac -> import) is the proposed method.
action_items: Participants will review the detailed asset migration process tomorrow morning.
